description:
The image shows a wooden board with a painting of a toaster on it. 

*   The painting is of a white toaster with black trim and a black handle.
    *   It is painted in a style that resembles graffiti art, with bold lines and bright colors.
    *   The toaster is centered on the board and takes up most of the space.
*   There are also some words and symbols written on the board, including "LOVE you" and a red circle with a white outline
